title: Programming task under no-help, chatbot, and code-generation conditions
summary: Students complete a programming task under one of three support conditions: no external help, an AI chatbot, or a generative coding tool such as GitHub Copilot. Pre- and post-task quizzes and an interview capture performance and experience for the research study.

sources.title: An Exploratory Study on the Impact of AI tools on the Student Experience in Programming Courses: an Intersectional Analysis Approach

assessment.summary: Complete a programming task with assigned access to no help, an AI chatbot, or GitHub Copilot, alongside pre- and post-task quizzes.
student_actions: Complete the assigned programming task under one support condition.
Take a post-task quiz and interview.

student_role.description: AI access depends on the assigned experimental condition.

allowed_purposes: Programming-task support in assigned AI conditions
